text: The owned first-file save task uses Assert.equal(await pickerPromise, "testmsg.eml") without a message. Accepted code still omits messages on both direct defaultString filename comparisons, while nearby file/content assertions do have messages. A task name, nearby comment or a different assertion's text does not supply the missing argument. This is a scoped source-review finding, not a failed test or a missing-should-only complaint.
title: EML save filename assertions still omit expected-behavior messages
